title: Light and Color
scene: Overlap red, green and blue spotlights on a white laboratory wall.

title: Element Cards
scene: Arrange illustrated element cards around a simplified periodic-table board.

title: Acorn Tower
scene: Drop a wooden acorn block onto a gently swaying tower, keeping its center of mass above the base.

title: Body Explorer
lesson: Anatomy, organs and what they do
scene: Fit illustrated organ pieces into a friendly transparent body model.

title: Density Tank
scene: Drop equal-volume objects of different densities into a clear water tank.

title: Magnet Maze
scene: Guide a steel bead through a maze using a movable magnet outside the glass.

title: Rope Friends
scene: Cut one support rope so a seed swings into a waiting planter.

title: Seed Sling
scene: Adjust a slingshot angle to launch a seed along a visible parabolic path.

title: Atom Merge
scene: Connect atom models into a correctly bonded water molecule on a workbench.

title: Circuit Garden
scene: Close a simple battery, resistor and lamp circuit on a safe low-voltage breadboard.

title: Optics Bench
scene: Move a convex lens along an optical bench to bring light to a focus.

title: Simple Machines
scene: Arrange a lever, pulley and wheel into a small chain-reaction machine.

title: Sound Waves
scene: Match a plucked string's vibration to a visible oscilloscope wave.

title: Weather Maker
scene: Adjust sun and water inputs in a miniature water-cycle terrarium.

title: Bridge Builder
scene: Place bridge beams between riverbanks with tension and compression overlays.

title: Sand and Water
scene: Draw a barrier in a falling-sand sandbox to redirect water into a reservoir.

title: Microscope Explorer
scene: Move a microscope slide to observe a magnified cell with clearly drawn structures.

title: Momentum Pinball
scene: Use two flippers to guide a polished ball through a botanical laboratory pinball table with spring bumpers.

title: Prism Breaker
scene: Move a small paddle to bounce a light sphere through an ordered wall of translucent research tiles.

title: Watergate Pins
scene: Remove a brass pin between transparent chambers so clean water reaches a thirsty seedling.
